title: Driver Risk Standard: Standing Scale on the Quest Pro Boost
content:
## Standard

The Pro boost on a quest reward under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** is subject to a standing scale: the Pro boost rate is first multiplied by the standing scale, and the stated reward amount is then multiplied by one plus that product. The standing scale follows the quality warnings recorded on the driver's standing record, the standing record of the driver's agreement under **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing**, within the last 6 whole months:

- 2 or more warnings set it at zero, so no boost is paid;
- at least one but fewer than 2 warnings set it at 0.5;
- no warning sets it at one, so the boost is paid in full.

## Scale by warnings

| Quality warnings in the last 6 whole months | Standing scale | Effect on the boost |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | Boost paid in full |
| 1 | 0.5 | Half the boost rate applies |
| 2 or more | 0 | No boost paid |

Only quality warnings count; other entries on the standing record (safety reports, document entries, rating reviews, background rechecks) do not. A quality warning recorded earlier than the last 6 whole months does not count.

## Hypothetical figures

A stated reward of 100.00 with a Pro boost rate of 0.1:

| Quality warnings | Boost rate multiplied by the standing scale | Reward after the boost |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.1 | 110.00 |
| 1 | 0.05 | 105.00 |
| 2 | 0 | 100.00 |
